text:
```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**/*.rs'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.rs'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - 'AGENTS.md'

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'
        scope: '@oxc-project'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        npm install -g just
        npm install

    - name: Generate API Documentation
      run: just generate-docs

    - name: Code Structure Analysis
      run: just analyze-code

    - name: Configuration Extraction
      run: just extract-config

    - name: Test Information
      run: just map-tests

    - name: Create AI Context Bundle
      run: just create-bundle

    - name: Validate AGENTS.md
      run: just validate-agents-md

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: ai-context-bundle
        path: bundle.zip
```
